modelOverview: The Patek Philippe ladies' Aquanaut, best known within the collection as the "Aquanaut Luce" (Italian for "light"), pairs the sporty 35.6mm Aquanaut case with a diamond-set bezel and an embossed guilloche dial matched to a tropical composite rubber strap. Introduced in 2004, the line has been produced in numerous dial/strap colourways across steel and precious-metal cases, with quartz movements for compact wearability. It sits alongside the larger unisex/men's Aquanaut references as Patek's dedicated ladies' sports-luxury offering.

5067A-025.year: Aquanaut Luce line introduced 2004; this Misty Blue dial variant (5067A-025) unveiled at Baselworld 2018
5067A-025.description: Reference 5067A-025 is a ladies' Patek Philippe Aquanaut Luce in stainless steel, distinguished by its factory diamond-set bezel and a distinctive "Misty Blue" embossed dial paired with a matching tropical rubber strap.
